directives.directive: For future Ralph implementation tasks, always run a targeted Playwright test/smoke that exercises the user-visible behavior affected by the changes, in addition to unit/integration tests, before declaring completion.

For future Ralph completions in this repo, append a coherent entry to docs/memory/ACTIVITY_LOG.md before cleanup/cancel, covering outcome, substantive work, files changed, verification evidence, blockers, and the true next state.

When Ralph executes from an approved plan in this repo and docs/TASK_PLAN.md exists, sync that plan into docs/TASK_PLAN.md before implementation using the existing area/task/status style; then reconcile major completed task sets during the run by marking implementation tasks COMPLETED and verified gates/checkpoints PASS with concise evidence notes.

When Ralph appends to docs/memory/ACTIVITY_LOG.md in this repo, follow the established structured format: heading `## <date> — Ralph — <cycle title>`, then Outcome, Summary, Files changed, Bugs fixed, Decisions made, Verification, Blockers, Next, and a trailing `---`; use `none` for non-applicable fields rather than omitting them.

When Ralph executes from an approved plan in this repo and docs/memory/DECISIONS.md exists, sync already-settled durable decisions from the approved plan into DECISIONS before implementation, then record any newly confirmed durable architecture/contract/runtime/security/source-of-truth decisions during execution using the existing DEC-XXX format; do not log ephemeral implementation trivia as decisions.

Override earlier Ralph decision-log timing for this repo: reconcile docs/memory/DECISIONS.md only at the two cycle boundaries of a complete Ralph run — once at startup from approved-plan durable decisions, and once at final completion for durable decisions confirmed by the run. Do not treat mid-run implementation moments as mandatory DECISIONS write points unless the user explicitly asks for it.

For Ralph runs in this repo, treat docs/TASK_PLAN.md, docs/memory/ACTIVITY_LOG.md, and docs/memory/DECISIONS.md as the canonical human ledgers. Do not auto-update docs/memory/PROGRESS.md or docs/memory/CONTEXT.md unless the user explicitly asks for it or a stricter repo rule later requires it.
